newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate eases on liquidity, peso.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate eases on liquidity, peso.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates closed down 95 basis points at 18.30 percent on Tuesday on ample market liquidity and a strong peso, traders said.

Dealers said liquidity pressures seen in recent sessions had eased as banks were no longer short on cash with which to meet Wednesday's deadline for settling balances outstanding on checking accounts held with the central bank.
"All players closed square or flat today and rates eased down on the strong peso. It was a technical adjustment after the recent speculative spike," a fixed-income analyst said.
Benchmark 48-hour peso contracts closed 0.6 of a centavo firmer at 7.8050/7.8090 per dollar.
Banco de Mexico drained 2.102 billion pesos from the market through three direct paper sales and four repos.
Overnight rates on bank paper meanwhile declined 190 basis points to 19.85 percent.
Liquidity of 711 million pesos was scheduled to return to the system on Wednesday from prior central bank participation.
